description: This photograph depicts a diverse landscape seen from an elevated viewpoint under a clear blue sky. A winding, blue-grey river flows through the foreground and mid-ground, intensely bordered by dense, lush green broadleaved trees, which represent riparian forest. Based on the document context, these trees likely include species such as _Alnus_, _Populus_, _Quercus_, _Ulmus_, _Fraxinus excelsior_, _Tilia cordata_, or _Acer platanoides_ (EUNIS G1.A, G1.B, G1.4), which are characteristic of broadleaved swamp woods or broadleaved forest growing on wet ground. Beyond the riverine vegetation, the landscape rises to include rolling hills with distinct agricultural fields showing row crops, possibly vineyards, alongside patches of sparser, lighter green vegetation. In the mid-distance, a large, light-coloured structure is visible on a hilltop, and further back, a small town or settlement appears on a hillside. A range of mountains forms the horizon in the far background. A small, orange-roofed building is visible on the right in the foreground, indicating scattered infrastructure.
